name: SnapType
tagline: Instant text expansion & crisp OLED rendering for Windows
problem: Windows lacks built-in text replacement and proper subpixel rendering for modern OLED monitors, forcing power users to juggle multiple tools or tolerate blurry text.
solution: SnapType combines a lightweight text expander with an OLED-aware font renderer, letting you insert snippets instantly and enjoy sharp, color-fringe-free text on any display.
features: Global text expansion with custom triggers
Per-monitor OLED subpixel rendering profiles (WRGB, RGB triangular)
Cloud sync of snippets across devices
Rich snippet support (formatted text, images, dynamic fields)
Auto-detect monitor subpixel layout via EDID
mvp_scope: Build a system tray app with global text expansion using Windows hooks, and a DirectWrite-based font renderer that applies custom subpixel geometry per monitor. Ship with 3 preset OLED profiles and manual calibration.
tech_stack: Microsoft Graph API for cloud sync

competitors.name: PowerToys
competitors.gap: Text expansion exists but no OLED subpixel rendering; UI clunky for snippet management.

competitors.name: Espanso
competitors.gap: Cross-platform but no Windows-specific font rendering; config file only, no GUI.

competitors.name: PhraseExpress
competitors.gap: Expensive subscription; no OLED rendering; Windows-only but heavy.

competitors.name: MacType
competitors.gap: Improves font rendering but no text expansion; complex setup, no per-monitor profiles.

competitors.name: BetterClearType
competitors.gap: Only ClearType tuning; no text expansion; limited to RGB stripe.

landing_copy.headline: Stop typing the same things. See text clearly on OLED.
landing_copy.subheadline: SnapType gives you instant text expansion and monitor-perfect font rendering in one lightweight Windows app.
bullets: Insert emails, addresses, code blocks with a few keystrokes
Eliminate color fringing on WOLED & QD-OLED monitors
Sync snippets securely across all your PCs
Zero latency, runs in the background at <10MB RAM

whatsapp_bot.flow: User messages 'snip <trigger> <text>' to save a snippet; 'list' shows all; 'sync' pushes to Windows app via cloud. Bot also sends daily tip for OLED calibration.
whatsapp_bot.pricing: Free for 50 snippets; $19/year for unlimited + cloud sync + OLED profiles

pricing_model: Freemium: free tier (50 snippets, basic rendering), Pro $19/year (unlimited snippets, cloud sync, advanced OLED profiles, priority support)
